question: If Petra, who has given poor evaluations of all the men in the mansion besides Subaru, were to evaluate the men of the other camps, I'd like to know how that would go...! Would she give Julius and such a positive evaluation?
answer: She wouldn't give an opinion on someone she's never met. They met briefly when Julius came to the mansion, but I think her evaluation would be, roughly, "He has a cool-looking face.".
